pages.text: Craft a birdhouse $(l)Mailbox$() from 6 planks in a little house shape around a Stamp. The planks pick its wood!$(br2)Right-click it and set an ID, like your name. A letter peeks out when mail arrives.
pages.title: Your Mailbox

pages.text: Craft a $(l)Letter$() (paper + feather) and right-click to write.$(br2)Press $(l)Sign$() and enter your friend's mailbox ID as the recipient, then right-click $(l)any$() mailbox. A mail carrier walks over and takes it to them!
pages.title: Letters

pages.text: Craft a $(l)Package$() (chest + stamp), place it and put up to 5 things inside.$(br2)Type a mailbox ID in $(l)Recipient$() and press $(l)Send$(). It lands in their mailbox, and disappears once they empty it.
pages.title: Packages

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Letter$(): paper + feather$(li)$(l)Stamps$(): paper + any dye$(li)$(l)Mailbox$(): 6 planks + stamp$(li)$(l)Package$(): chest + stamp$(li)$(l)Package Controller$(): package + paper + redstone (tracks deliveries)
